purpose: locsim1: locationd's built-in 'simulated location from defaults' -- six CLPreferences keys (SimulatedLocation*) added to /private/var/mobile/Library/Preferences/com.apple.locationd.plist (coordinates in sim.json: placeholder Rome 41.9028,12.4964, accuracy 10 m, type 1 = GPS inferred). Read by CLSimulationController when the simulation service begins (locationd 0x10084e428). Previous values in /private/var/db/nord2-locsim/receipt.json. Undo: guest-locsim1-undo.sh + payload-locsim1-undo + owned-locsim1.json.
